$description: The two colours of a code a camera reads. Like the brand values these do NOT change between themes or modes: a phone reads dark modules on a light ground and cannot read the reverse, so a QR code keeps a light plate under dark ink on a dark page too. Use these only for a machine-readable code. Anything a person reads uses the theme tokens.

scan-plate.$description: The ground of a machine-readable code, quiet zone included. The parchment of the light logo tile, as a value of its own so that neither can be retuned by way of the other.

scan-ink.$description: The dark modules of a machine-readable code. Held at 7:1 on --scan-plate by check:contrast.
